name: Pathauto Condition UI
description: Provides a UI for managing additional conditions on Pathauto alias generation.
project_description:
The Pathauto Conditions UI module is an extension for the popular Pathauto module. It adds administrative UI for creating and managing additional conditions that are considered when generating Pathauto aliases. After enabling the module you will find the UI alongside Pathauto-related settings in the administrative interface. Use the UI to:

 
 Add new conditions that control whether a pattern is applied for a particular entity or route. 
 Edit or remove existing conditions. 
 
 This module is born out of the contributions from [#3224916] and might at some point be merged into the main module.
